collections.title: Crochet Bouquets
collections.description: Crochet flower bouquets, made by hand in India. Sunflowers, roses, tulips and daisies are crocheted stem by stem, then wrapped in black and gold and tied with a ribbon, ready to give. Choose a single flower, a pair or a bouquet of three. They need no water and they never wilt.
seo: Handmade Crochet Flower Bouquets | Yarn Basket
Crochet flower bouquets made by hand in India: sunflowers, roses, tulips and daisies that never wilt. Wrapped and ready to gift.
about: Every bouquet here is crochet from petal to stem. Priya makes each flower by hand from soft yarn, shapes it, sets it on a stem with its leaves, and wraps the bouquet herself. Some people call them woolen flower bouquets or yarn flowers. Whatever the name, they are flowers that stay.

There are single stems for a small thank you, pairs, and bouquets of three for birthdays and anniversaries. Some come in a choice of colours, and in a few you choose the third flower yourself. One has a smiling bee on its own stem.

A crochet bouquet takes about an hour to make, more for the larger ones, so no two are exactly alike. It can stand in a vase, lie on a shelf or stay in its wrap. It suits anyone who would love flowers they can keep.
questions: How long does a crochet flower bouquet last?
For years. Crochet flowers do not wilt, dry out or drop petals, and they need no water. Keep the bouquet out of strong direct sunlight and its colours stay bright.
Does the bouquet come wrapped?
Yes. Every bouquet is wrapped in black and gold and tied with a ribbon before it is packed, so it is ready to give when it arrives.
Can I choose the flowers or the colours?

Many bouquets have a choice of colour or of the third flower on their page. For anything else, such as other colours or a bigger bouquet, message us on WhatsApp or through the Contact page and Priya will tell you what she can make.
Can crochet flowers be washed?
Yes, gently. Take the flowers out of their wrap first so the wrap stays dry, then hand wash them in cool water, press the water out without wringing, and dry them flat in the shade.

collections.title: Crochet Keychains
collections.description: Crochet keychains, made by hand in India: sunflowers, daisies, an evil eye, a peacock feather, a bee, a chick and a baby octopus. Each one is crocheted from soft yarn and comes on a metal ring and chain, for keys, a bag or a zip. Buy one, a pair or a set of three.
seo: Handmade Crochet Keychains | Yarn Basket
Crochet keychains made by hand in India: sunflower, daisy, evil eye, peacock feather, bee and chick. Singles and gift sets.
about: These are small pieces, and each is made one at a time. A crochet keychain takes Priya about half an hour: the flower or the little character is crocheted by hand, the round ones are stuffed, and then it is fixed to its ring. If you have been looking for a handmade wool keychain, this is it.

The flowers are the sunflower and the daisy, in white or blue. The evil eye and the peacock feather are the ones people give for luck. The bee, the chick in its eggshell and the octopus are the ones that make people smile.

Sets put two or three keychains together, most of them for less than the same pieces bought one by one, which makes them easy gifts to share between friends, cousins or a whole class. They suit women and men, keys and school bags alike.
questions: What is the keychain attached to?
Every keychain comes on a metal ring with a short chain. It goes on a key ring, a bag strap, a pencil case or the pull of a zip.
How do I wash a crochet keychain?
Hand wash it in cool water, press the water out gently without wringing, and let it dry flat in the shade. Dry the metal ring with a cloth afterwards.
Can I order many keychains as return gifts?

Yes. Keychains make good return gifts for birthdays and weddings. Message us on WhatsApp or through the Contact page with the number you need and the date, and Priya will tell you how long it will take.
Is each keychain exactly like the photo?
Very close, but not identical. Each one is crocheted by hand, so a petal or a smile may sit a little differently. The colours and the design are the ones you see.

collections.title: Crochet Hair Accessories
collections.description: Crochet hair accessories, made by hand in India: hair clips topped with flowers, tie-on headbands, claw clips, little heart hair pins and soft scrunchies. They are light enough to wear all day, and they suit girls and women alike. Most come as a pair, and a few as a matching set.
seo: Handmade Crochet Hair Accessories | Yarn Basket
Crochet flower headbands and hair clips, made by hand in India. Light, soft and made to be worn every day.
about: Each flower is crocheted by hand from soft yarn, then fixed to its clip, pin or band. The snap clips and hair pins are for every day. The claw clips are big enough to hold a bun. The headbands are a chain of small flowers on a cord that ties at the back, so one size fits a child and a grown-up.
There are daisies in cream and blue, sunflowers, white flowers with lavender centres, hearts in ten colours, and a saffron, white and green pair for Independence Day and Republic Day.

Sets bring matching pieces together, such as a headband with its clips, or a sunflower headband, keychain, clips and hair tie in one. They are easy gifts for a daughter, a sister or a friend, and for school functions.
questions: Are these for children or for adults?
Both. The clips and pins are light and small enough for a child, and the headbands tie at the back, so they fit any head. The claw clips are best for longer hair.
Will the crochet flower come off the clip?
Each flower is fixed to its clip, pin or band by hand. Treat it as you would any hair clip: open it by the clip, not by pulling on the flower.
How do I clean crochet hair clips?
Wipe the flower with a damp cloth, or wash it gently by hand in cool water and dry it flat in the shade. Dry the metal clip with a cloth so it stays bright.

The lily of the valley charm ties on rather than clips, which is why it works in two ways: on the handle of a handbag, a tote or a school bag, and as a bow around a ponytail or a plait. Pink and white go well together, which is why there is a pair.
It is a light, easy gift for a friend, a sister or a bridesmaid. The same charm also comes in a set with our sunflower keychain, which you will find with the keychains.
questions: How does the charm attach to a bag?
It ties on. Knot its green cord around a bag handle, a strap ring or a zip pull, and the two bell flowers hang below.
Can I wear it in my hair?
Yes. Tie it over a hair tie around a ponytail or at the end of a plait. One of our photos shows it worn this way.
Can you make the charm in other colours?
Pink and white are the colours we keep ready. For another colour, or for a number of charms for a wedding or a party, message us on WhatsApp or through the Contact page.

questions: Does the crochet pot stand up by itself?
Yes. It is made to stand upright by itself on a desk, a shelf or a windowsill, without a vase or any support.
Is the pot real, or is it crochet too?
It is crochet too. The pot, the soil, the leaves and the flower are all crocheted by hand from yarn.
How do I keep it clean?
Dust it with a soft dry brush or cloth now and then. If it needs more, wipe it with a damp cloth and let it dry in the shade. Keep it out of strong direct sunlight so the colours stay bright.

collections.title: Crochet Home Decor

One for each curtain panel. A window with two curtains needs a pack of two, and two windows need a pack of four.

Yarn keeps its colour well indoors. Strong direct sunlight for hours every day can soften any colour over time, so a window that gets shade or filtered light is best.

The sunflower keychain and the pair of sunflower hair clips are the smallest. The single sunflower bouquet is the smallest bouquet.
Do crochet sunflowers fade?
Not in normal use. They never wilt and need no water. Keep them out of strong direct sunlight and the yellow stays bright for years.
